sv.title: Börsen tog helg med starka uppgångar
sv.summary: Stockholmsbörsen tog helg med den andra starka handelsdagen i rad. Gruvrelaterade aktier gick stark när metallpriserna rekylerade uppåt. Samtidigt rasade årets hittills bäst presterande aktie.

en.title: Stock market takes weekend with strong gains
en.summary: The Stockholm stock exchange took the weekend with the second strong trading day in a row. Mining-related shares rose strongly as metal prices rebounded upwards. Meanwhile, this year's best-performing share so far plunged.
